findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The widened backfill search records a PR merged exactly 42 days before a Sunday run, but this board change restores expired rows only when the PR appears in the board's Monday-based weekly searches. Those searches begin 41 days before that Sunday. The in-scope item therefore remains absent from `forge board --json`, so its rebuilt time cannot be shown. This is a board visibility gap beyond the earlier ruling about widening backfill's search.
findings.title: Not done: the exact-cut item's rebuilt time is visible on the board

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. Backfill includes `story/` PRs, but this condition records an approval actor only for part keys containing `/`. For a squash-merged story whose branch was deleted, the approval commit is available from the fetched pull ref but `board._approver` searches only named Git refs, so `approved_by` is lost. The board also skips `time_records.combined` for story rows (`board.py:531-534`) and derives their time from parts (`board.py:624`), so the story's own rebuilt record never supplies its promised history label.
findings.title: Not done: rebuilt story history reaches the board

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The fixture's blocked review has one finding and its clean review has none, so this assertion expects zero repeated findings in both rounds. Backfill could classify every repeated historical finding as new or unknown and the named end-to-end proof would still pass, despite Done-when requiring new versus repeated classification from committed results.
findings.title: Not done: the upgrade test proves repeated historical findings
